text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after returning to the academy with Loves Only You following the end of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While training to put the fruits of our summer camp to the test—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh……——
choice_data_list: Loves!? Are you hurt anywhere!?
Loves!? Does it hurt anywhere!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Wait, my right leg is...—
choice_data_list: Let's get a doctor to see you right away. First, some first aid—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...By the time we finished the checkup at the hospital and returned to the academy, the sun had completely set—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: “—I never imagined I'd go and hurt my right hoof this time around, of all things...”
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I found it so quickly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to catching the injury to Loves Only You's right hoof early,
it was resolved without having a fatal impact on her career as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even so, an impact on her performance in the Shuka Sho is unavoidable. We definitely need to reconsider our upcoming race schedule..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It kind of reminds me of last year.
Though back then it was phlegmon—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Still, precisely because it's a similar situation,
we know what we need to do next.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's times like these you mustn't rush...!
Yeah. Times like this are exactly when we shouldn't rush...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Just like back then, let's think about the future together again♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she has already mentally come to terms
with her injury. I must live up to her positive attitude.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, actually—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going to review my rotation anyway,
I want to take this chance to think about the autumn season and beyond...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I want to create a race rotation
that can prove my love in a way
that is even more true to myself...!
choice_data_list: More like yourself, huh?
More like your true self, huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was giving it some thought
during the summer training camp... for example—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: My classmate Gran-chan has even been taking on non-mile races just to prove she's the greatest miler in history—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Because Chrono-chan wants to be an active part of racing history, she's fixated on the classic route and the Grand Prix—the very forefront of the era..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I want to realize that sort of... "individuality" in my upcoming race rotation, too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"In other words,
as Loves Only You on the Tiara path,
you want that little something extra... is that it?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I thought that having that little extra something, that individuality of mine,
would let me deliver even more love to the Commu-members—
choice_data_list: Then we already have it. The ideal 'Loves-ness' we should aim for.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Now's the time to aim for it—the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through her races up to this day, Loves Only You has steadily built up her reputation as a top-tier Tiara contender.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can secure another GⅠ victory
this autumn, she should have more than enough
of a track record to challenge overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For our initial goal, the Shuka Sho,
there's a high chance lingering effects from the injury remain.
If so, a more appropriate new goal would be—
choice_data_list: First, let's enter the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just like the Shuka Sho, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is a 2,200m turf medium-distance G1 held at Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since this race takes place slightly after the Shuka Sho,
there is a higher chance Loves Only You can challenge it fully recovered from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Senior-class runners will be participating
in this race. Because of that, the competition will be stiffer
than the Shuka Sho, but—
choice_data_list: If it's you, Loves, you should be more than capable of competing.
If it's you, Loves, I know you can put up a great fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And riding high on our result at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, next comes—"
choice_data_list: Aim for the Hong Kong International GⅠ...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a middle-distance GⅠ race that
Japanese Umamusume have won in the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning here will instantly make a name for her
as a world-class Umamusume.
And then, as the next step—"
choice_data_list: I'll run in Dubai's international GⅠ too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Gentildonna, who made a legendary name for herself on the Tiara route. She, too, has tasted victory in Dubai's international GⅠ."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For Loves Only You, a fellow Tiara-route Umamusume,
this race would make the perfect goal...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"From the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
to international GⅠ races in Hong Kong and Dubai...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Amazing...!
Just hearing about it is giving me chills...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, really...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, really...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for someone like me... to run such a lovely rotation...?!
choice_data_list: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You is an Umamusume already capable of running on the world stage.
And above all else—
choice_data_list: I'm here to help you spread your wings across the world.
I'm here to help you spread your wings to the world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun.
Take responsibility for this, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan.
You'd better take proper responsibility, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
With my heart racing like this,
how could I possibly think of any other race rotation...!
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for it. First up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
Then let's aim for it. First up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
I will definitely deliver results...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, switching her goal from the Shuka Sho
to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, she set her sights
on the world stage—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —And so, starting with the Queen Elizabeth II Cup this autumn, we've decided to aim for the world♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"What a crazy hype development!!" "Amazing!" "For real?!"
"She's finally taking on the world!" "Can't wait!!"
"Bridge-san! You've gotta send her out to conquer the world!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Bridge-san, you absolutely have to send me out into the world..." she says♡
choice_data_list: "Without fail!!"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"That's our bridge between worlds!" "Well said!"
"We'll keep cheering for you!" "As expected!"
"888888" "So cool~!" "Go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it. With everyone's support, I'll definitely show my running to the whole world...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, both Loves Only You and I were fired up
by the support from our community members,
taking our next steps into the autumn season—
